summary: Tested Robinity 'Connect X' feature end-to-end. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass covering /api/x/config, /auth/login (503 unconfigured), /me (null / with session), /auth/dev-login redirect + cookie, /evm (401 no auth, 400 invalid, 200 valid, 409 duplicate), /tasks/{id}/verify (404 unknown, 503 for like_rt & quote without tweet, 200 follow with dev token yields done:true verified:false), /logout. Frontend Playwright covered: landing shows x-connect-button; unconfigured Connect toast; dev-login populates x-profile (@robinity_tester) and tasks-button; tasks-modal opens with evm-form; invalid EVM error toast; valid EVM (0xaaa...) saves, shows tasks-progress 0/3 and truncated wallet; like_rt open button shows 'not configured' toast; follow verify button disabled until open clicked (stubbed window.open, url intent/follow verified); follow verify -> task-follow-done + progress 1/3; modal closes via close button, backdrop and Escape; page reload preserves session and follow-done state; disconnect returns header to connect button; mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow and header visible.
critical_code_review_comments: x_router.py: /auth/dev-login should be idempotent for smoke tests (currently upserts user but always inserts a new session; low-risk, minor).

x-connect.jsx: window.open called with 'noopener' - opener is null which is fine for Playwright too, but the popup 'page' event was not captured in Chromium; not a product bug, only affects e2e; testing worked with window.open stub.

x_router.py check_follow does up to 5 * 1000 following pages per verify call — potentially heavy and rate-limited for large accounts once real X creds are configured; consider caching or lower page count.
EVM address is normalized as user typed (mixed case accepted). Consider lower-casing before storing for canonical comparisons.
test_credentials: Dev mock: GET /api/x/auth/dev-login (X_DEV_MOCK=1) -> user @robinity_tester. Reset with: mongosh test_database --eval 'db.x_users.deleteMany({x_id:"dev-000001"}); db.x_sessions.deleteMany({x_id:"dev-000001"});'
seed_data_creation: None persisted; dev mock user cleaned up at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is a prebuilt esbuild bundle (no hot reload) served by /app/robinitypage/serve.js. Do NOT modify frontend files. Backend at :8001 with /api/x/* under /app/backend/x_router.py. Real X OAuth is not configured; use dev-login. Reset mongo between test runs. When testing window.open in Playwright with noopener, stub window.open in-page (see test) — do not use expect_page.
